COVERED. scout/scout_gazebo_sim/launch/scout_empty_world.launch only (Scout V2). It includes gazebo_ros empty_world.launch (line 7) with paused false, use_sim_time true and gui true (lines 8-13), then spawn_scout_v2.launch (line 16). The live model plugin is gazebo_ros_control, libgazebo_ros_control.so (scout_v2.gazebo:26-30). x-cap.agilexrobotics.cmd_vel.v1 publishes geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel. The constructor sets cmd_topic_ to robot_name_ + "/cmd_vel" (scout_skid_steer.cpp:22). The launch default robot_namespace is / (scout_empty_world.launch:3), so the concatenated C++ string is //cmd_vel. This package binds the literal suffix /cmd_vel and does not cite a ROS name-cleaning function. If the private parameter is absent, the C++ default is scout_default (scout_skid_steer_controller.cpp:18-20) and the topic is the relative name scout_default/cmd_vel, which is not bound. The shipped spawn sets the parameter from the launch arg (spawn_scout_v2.launch:37-38). Inputs are linear_x and angular_z only (callback lines 41-42). linear.y is sent as 0 and is not an input. Limits are operator_required. The receipt reports sent_linear_x and sent_angular_z. A zero Twist makes the callback publish four zero Float64 values (lines 40-57). That is not evidence that a JointVelocityController replaced a held setpoint.

VERIFIER CORRECTIONS. The triage's live skid-steer plugin is wrong: libgazebo_ros_skid_steer_drive.so (scout_v2.gazebo:43-63) and libgazebo_ros_planar_move.so (lines 65-73) are inside XML comments. Those comments name odom. This package does not bind odometry and does not claim a skid-steer plugin. The in-repo command path is ScoutSkidSteer::TwistCmdCallback, which does not store the Twist. SCOUT_WHEELBASE 0.498 and SCOUT_WHEEL_RADIUS 0.16459 (scout_skid_steer.hpp:33-34) are kinematics, not velocity limits. The yaml PID gains are controller gains, not velocity limits.

SAFETY. risk R2 (card floor R0). The e-stop is companion /gazebo/pause_physics (std_srvs/Empty), confirmed only when /gazebo/get_physics_properties reports pause true (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:462-468, 1662-1666, 364-370, 1426). getPhysicsProperties returns false when the engine is not ode (lines 1433-1465); empty_world.launch defaults physics to ode. No unpause and no re-enable. The four velocity_controllers/JointVelocityController entries (scout_v2_control.yaml:11-40) are implemented by ros-controllers, which this clone does not contain (scout/README.md:36 installs ros-melodic-ros-controllers). A zero Twist cannot be shown to clear a held setpoint before an unpause, so SAFE-042 refuses unpause. mhs.safety.reset releases the latch and leaves the world paused. The operator recovers outside MHS. spawn_model is invoked with -unpause (spawn_scout_v2.launch:25) and -model 'scout$(arg robot_namespace)' (line 28); this package does not spawn and does not select a model by that name. unpausePhysics exists in the companion (lines 1668-1672) and is not called. The read-back is the paused flag at that call, not a measured standstill and not a promise that World::Update or a controller stays idle. World::Step still calls ProcessMessages while paused (World.cc:691-718). A WorldControl multi_step runs steps while paused (lines 1462-1477). The Gazebo GUI or any other client can unpause. scout_skid_steer_controller calls ros::spin (scout_skid_steer_controller.cpp:27), so it can receive a Twist while Gazebo is paused; whether the external controllers apply the Float64 publications is not in this clone.

NOT A COMMAND. /gazebo/model_states is documented in facts only. The clone never names that topic, and ROS_COMPANION_SCOPE forbids a command binding from citing a companion. The API plugin advertises the relative name model_states as gazebo_msgs::ModelStates (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:382-388) on the private node handle (line 147). onModelStatesConnect hooks publishModelStates to WorldUpdateBegin on the first subscriber (lines 554-558), so the topic is silent only while World::Update does not run, and Update still runs while paused when stepInc > 0 or needsReset is true (World.cc:691-697). publishModelStates fills name, pose and twist from GetName, WorldPose, WorldLinearVel and WorldAngularVel (lines 2203-2244). ModelStates.msg comments call pose and twist desired (gazebo_msgs/msg/ModelStates.msg:1-4); the publisher uses the world pose and velocity. joint_states is not bound: scout_v2_control.yaml names joint_state_controller/JointStateController and publish_rate 50 (lines 2-4) and names no topic. The device resource reads no topic.
